basis: Current first-party standard API rates, applied to historical requests as an equivalent-cost estimate; not historical invoices or subscription charges.
assumptions: Qwen uses Singapore International rates with explicit-cache reads. Implicit-cache reads and other regions have different rates.
DeepSeek base prices are peak rates; requests outside 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC Monday–Friday get the published 50% discount.
Context tiers are selected per request, including cached input and writes, before summing usage.
Fast, priority, batch, flex, residency, tax, third-party hosting and tool charges are not inferred from model names.
Kimi K3 cache writes use the published default write rate; no separate one-hour rate was available in the retrieved price table.
Legacy models retain their last published rates when no current price is listed.
No default USD rate is assigned to Doubao Seed Code (region/currency not established). Use an explicit local pricing override.
The observed route-qualified IDs ATXC44Y9/gpt-6-astra and 8TZQGKP5/gpt-6-astra use first-party GPT-6 Astra equivalent rates; hosting or routing markups are not included.
codex-auto-review remains unpriced at the user's request: no verified public token price or underlying-model mapping was found. Do not substitute another model's rates.

coverage.scope: All model IDs visible in stored Team history, queried read-only.
coverage.historical_costs: Team reads costs previously uploaded by each member. A rate-table update applies when clients rescan and upload; it does not rewrite other members' stored costs. Rows with missing input/output/cache token components remain incomplete.
